meta.subject: fix bug in cdma img pack, data bank depth configurable logic missing in data cbuf writing addr control logic

en.summary: Fixes CDMA image-pack circular-buffer write addressing so base-wrap and address-wrap calculations scale with the configured CBUF bank depth instead of a hard-coded default slice.
why_it_counts: The patch changes only DUT RTL in the image-pack write-address path.
The modified logic computes base and final write addresses for CBUF writes, which is directly functional DUT behavior.
The old code assumed a fixed bank-depth bit split and therefore miswrapped addresses in configurable-bank-depth designs.
evidence: The commit message explicitly says bank-depth configurable logic was missing in CBUF write-address control.
The fix widens `pk_rsp_wr_addr_wrap` and `pk_rsp_wr_base_wrap` and replaces hard-coded `[15:9]` and `[16:9]` style logic with `NVDLA_CBUF_BANK_DEPTH_LOG2`-based expressions.
The updated subtraction removes `pixel_bank << bank_depth` rather than only the unshifted bank-count field.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Circular buffer address generators typically split an address into a bank index and an in-bank offset. If wrap detection and wrap subtraction are written against a fixed default bit split instead of the configured bank-depth granularity, the address generator works only for one layout. Under other bank depths, the producer wraps at the wrong threshold and writes data into the wrong physical bank or row.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: circular-buffer wrap detection and wrap subtraction
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A design variant where the local data buffer bank depth differs from the hard-coded default assumed by the buggy logic.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore fixed bit slicing for wrap compare and wrap subtraction so the logic ignores the configurable bank-depth parameter.
portability_notes: Apply this where a packed-image or line-buffer writer increments a circular address across multiple banks.
The bug requires a design with configurable bank depth or an equivalent tunable bank-offset granularity.
Both the wrap compare and the value subtracted on wrap must use the wrong fixed granularity for the bug to match the real patch.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the write-base and final write-address calculations for the circular data buffer.
Replace parameterized bank-depth-based compare slices with fixed high-bit slices that assume the default bank depth.
On wrap, subtract only the bank-count field or an incorrectly shifted bank span instead of the full bank span at the configured depth.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA IMG pack `pk_rsp_wr_base_*` and `pk_rsp_wr_addr_*` wrap logic
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix rewrites base-wrap and address-wrap generation to use `NVDLA_CBUF_BANK_DEPTH_LOG2` when comparing and subtracting `pixel_bank`, and widens the wrap intermediate signals accordingly.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Reinstate the commented fixed-depth forms around `is_base_wrap`, `pk_rsp_wr_base_wrap`, `is_addr_wrap`, and `pk_rsp_wr_addr_wrap` that use hard-coded `[15:9]` and `[16:9]` style slices.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: On non-default bank-depth configurations, packed image data wraps to the wrong CBUF row or bank, corrupting subsequent reads without changing the higher-level control flow.
evidence_for_injection: The patch is entirely concentrated in base/address wrap compare and subtract expressions.
The new expressions explicitly shift `pixel_bank` by the configured bank depth, which the old logic omitted.
The widened wrap temporaries show the old implementation was not just stylistically fixed; the arithmetic width itself depended on the missing parameterization.
notes: This fault is easiest to expose on configurations that change bank depth from the default value assumed by the pre-fix code.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 CDMA image-pack 的循环缓冲区写地址逻辑，使 base-wrap 和 address-wrap 计算按配置的 CBUF bank depth 缩放，而不是依赖写死的默认位段。
why_it_counts: 补丁只修改了 image-pack 写地址路径中的 DUT RTL。
被修改逻辑负责计算写入 CBUF 的 base 和最终地址，属于直接的功能性 DUT 行为。
旧逻辑假设了固定 bank depth 的位划分，因此在可配置 bank depth 设计中会错误回绕地址。
evidence: 提交信息明确指出 CBUF 写地址控制缺少与 bank depth 配置相关的逻辑。
修复扩大了 `pk_rsp_wr_addr_wrap` 和 `pk_rsp_wr_base_wrap` 的位宽，并把写死的 `[15:9]`、`[16:9]` 形式替换为基于 `NVDLA_CBUF_BANK_DEPTH_LOG2` 的表达式。
新的减法使用的是 `pixel_bank << bank_depth`，而不是只减未移位的 bank 数字段。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 循环缓冲区地址发生器通常把地址拆成 bank 索引和 bank 内偏移。如果回绕检测和回绕减法基于固定默认位段，而不是基于实际配置的 bank-depth 粒度来编写，那么该地址发生器只会在一种布局下正确工作。换成其他 bank depth 时，生产者会在错误阈值回绕，从而把数据写到错误的物理 bank 或 row。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 循环缓冲区回绕检测与回绕减法
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 本地数据缓冲区的 bank depth 与错误逻辑默认假设值不同时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复写死的位切片方式进行回绕比较和回绕减法，使逻辑忽略可配置的 bank-depth 参数。
portability_notes: 应在跨多个 bank 递增循环地址的 packed-image 或 line-buffer 写路径上实施该故障。
该故障需要设计存在可配置的 bank depth，或等价的可调 bank-offset 粒度。
只有同时让回绕比较和回绕时的减法都使用错误的固定粒度，才能与真实补丁语义一致。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位循环数据缓冲区的写 base 和最终写地址计算逻辑。
把基于参数的 bank-depth 比较位段改回假定默认 bank depth 的固定高位切片。
在发生回绕时，只减去 bank 数字段或一个错误移位后的 bank 跨度，而不是按配置深度减去完整 bank 跨度。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA IMG pack 中 `pk_rsp_wr_base_*` 与 `pk_rsp_wr_addr_*` 的回绕逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复重写了 base-wrap 和 address-wrap 生成逻辑，在比较和减去 `pixel_bank` 时使用 `NVDLA_CBUF_BANK_DEPTH_LOG2`，并相应扩大了中间 wrap 信号位宽。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 `is_base_wrap`、`pk_rsp_wr_base_wrap`、`is_addr_wrap` 和 `pk_rsp_wr_addr_wrap` 周围被注释掉的固定深度形式，即使用写死的 `[15:9]`、`[16:9]` 风格切片。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在非默认 bank depth 配置下，打包后的图像数据会回绕到错误的 CBUF row 或 bank，后续读取被破坏，但高层控制流程表面上仍可能继续运行。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁完全聚焦在 base/address 的回绕比较和减法表达式上。
新的表达式显式按配置 bank depth 左移 `pixel_bank`，这是旧逻辑缺失的核心。
wrap 中间量位宽被扩大，说明修复不只是代码风格调整，而是实际算术宽度依赖于遗漏的参数化。
notes: 当 bank depth 改成不同于旧代码默认假设的值时，该故障最容易暴露。
